title: 高市首相がベトナム首相と会談、対中国を念頭に半導体や重要鉱物巡り連携強化を確認
extracted_text:
【ハノイ＝黒木健太朗】高市首相は２日午前（日本時間２日午後）、ハノイでベトナムのレ・ミン・フン首相と会談した。対中国を念頭に、人工知能（ＡＩ）や半導体などの経済安全保障分野や、重要鉱物を巡るサプライチェーン（供給網）の強靱化に向けた連携を確認した。
会談に先立ち、高市首相は首相府での歓迎式典に臨んだ。会談後には両首脳による共同記者発表を行い、首相は「ベトナムとの連携を強化することは、『自由で開かれたインド太平洋』の実現、進化に向けて極めて重要だ」と訴えた。
会談では、中東情勢が緊迫する中、医療関連など重要物資を日本に安定供給するため、ベトナムの製油所の支援策で一致した。高市首相が打ち出した総額約１００億ドル（約１・５兆円）のエネルギー調達を巡る金融支援枠組み「パワーアジア」の第１号案件となる。
ベトナムは南シナ海で中国と領有権を争っており、地域の平和と安定に向けて安全保障協力の具体化を進めることも確認した。その後、首相はベトナムの最高指導者トー・ラム共産党書記長・国家主席とも会談を予定している。
２日午後には、首相はハノイの大学で外交演説を行い、「自由で開かれたインド太平洋」の進化に向けた新たな構想を表明する。エネルギー・重要物資の供給網強化やルールの共有、安全保障分野での連携の三つの重点分野を打ち出す構えだ。
（詳しくはこちら）
translated_text: [Hanoi = Kenta Kuroki] Prime Minister Takachi met with Vietnamese Prime Minister Le Minh Phong in Hanoi on the morning of the 2nd (the afternoon of the 2nd in Japan time). With China in mind, the two leaders confirmed they will strengthen cooperation in economic security areas such as artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductors, as well as in strengthening the supply chain for critical minerals. Prior to the meeting, Prime Minister Takachi attended a welcoming ceremony at the Prime Minister's Office. After the talks, the two leaders held a joint press conference, with the Prime Minister stating, "Strengthening cooperation with Vietnam is extremely important for achieving and advancing a 'Free and Open Indo-Pacific.'" During the talks, amid the escalating Middle East situation, the two countries agreed on measures to support Vietnamese refineries to ensure stable supply of critical materials, including medical-related goods, to Japan. This will become the first project for the "Power Asia" financial support framework for energy procurement, with a total value of approximately $10 billion (about 1.5 trillion yen), which was announced by Prime Minister Takachi. Vietnam is engaged in a territorial dispute with China over the South China Sea, and they also confirmed that they will advance concrete cooperation in security cooperation for regional peace and stability. Following this, the Prime Minister is scheduled to meet with Vietnam's top leader, Party Secretary General and State President To Lam. In the afternoon of the 2nd, the Prime Minister delivered a foreign policy speech at a university in Hanoi, announcing a new concept for advancing the evolution of a "Free and Open Indo-Pacific." The speech is expected to outline three priority areas: strengthening supply networks for energy and critical materials, sharing rules, and cooperation in the security sector. title_en: Prime Minister Takachi Meets with Vietnamese PM, Confirms Strengthened Cooperation on Semiconductors and Critical Minerals with China in Mind
